purpose: Freeze the corrected publication-source workflow after restoring Stage1-200 scientific and visual discipline to current authorities.
current_scientific_model: Primary K5/R1-R5 lineage is exactly preserved from Stage106/121 into the current H5AD.

Soma-geometry claims are backed by full distributions and tissue context rather than effect-size-only heatmaps.
VTA/PCRT relationships are presented as target-biased molecular mixtures with section-resolved reproducibility, not one type-one projection.
Own scRNA, Luskin, and MapMyCells/Allen are shown as separate quantitative crosswalks rather than a binary support matrix.
